tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs 'bring po nyams su len tshul bde chen snying po bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī tsakra sam+bha ra ya/ 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs 'bring po nyams su len tshul mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog nag po lugs kyi nyams len bya tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rim pa gsal ba gzhir bzhag de nyid kyi ngag 'don rnams sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer bzhin nyams su len tshul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar zhes pa nas go 'phang mchog la 'god par bya'i bar/ de nas bdud rtsi ril bu myong ba'am/ med na nang mchod/ thod chang dngos 'byor yid sprul gang rung oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum brjod la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lce la bzhag cing myang / shrī he ru ko3haṃ nas/ maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥkyi bar/ oṃ sarba bid nas/ a warta ya ho bar phyag rgya se gol bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim zhes pa nas/ at+ma ko3haṃ bar/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i drwa ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dhe ni nas/ hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐ gi bar lan gsum gsum phyag rgya dang bcas brjod/ de lta bus srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du nas/ 'dres pa las bar/ rlung me chu sa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa rnams kyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi rtsig pa lnga pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu 'dod snam dang bcas pa steng thog rim par phub cing rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i nang gi lha snam/

shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa bcud kyis gang ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i dbus su gar bu sngon po gru bzhi pa'i steng du sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i rwa ba ka gdung thog phub bcas/ de'i steng du gsung 'khor dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i rwa ba ka gdung thog phub bcas/ de'i steng du thugs 'khor sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rwa ba ka gdung thog phub bcas/ de'i steng du bde chen 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gis mtshan pa'i rwa ba ka gdung thog phub dang bcas pa/ lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun po thams cad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan/ 'khor gyi gnas thams cad du ro'i gdan re re dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ klu brgyad/ chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ dpa' bo/ rnal 'byor ma/ 'dre/ srin po re re la'ang sha za/ lce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi zhes pa nas/ rgyab ser/ g.yon sngo bar phyag bcu gnyis phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i sku can du gyur/ zhes pa'am/ yang na sgrub thabs bzhin brjod kyang chog yab kyi gsang gnas nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'o bar/ yang yab kyi gsang gnas/ sogs mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs la/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang / oṃ sarba nas/ ma ku'i rnam pa can no'i bar/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te 'og rlung bskyod pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs snying kha'i rnam par shes pa'i rten khams dpa' bo hūm̐ gi rnam par gsal ba la yab dang /

phyi shun gyi rtsa hūm̐ gi dbyibs can la yum thim pas nang gi he ru ka yab yum du gyur pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ yar drangs pa phyir spros/ phyi'i gtso bo yab yum la thim/ mkha' nang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ rang gi lus kyi rtsa gnas so sor reg pas nang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal bar byas yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros/ phyi'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor so sor gyur pa ni/ snying kha'i nang 'khor gyi shar dang phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ zhes pa nas/ ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o bar/ snying kha'i nang 'khor gyi mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi dang / phyi bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir thod pabadud rtsis gang ba bzhi la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /nang gi spyi bo so dang / sen mo'i khams dang zhes pa nas/ nyi ma ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o bar/ snying kha'i phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi shar dang / phyi dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o bar/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje nas/ brgyad rnams su gyur bar/ phyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ bdag gis sgom pa'i nas/ byang shar ba rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan gyi bar/ sngags mchod dor la/ phyi mchod bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rol mo bcas pa mtshan sngags sbyar la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du༞ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la rang gis myang / yi ge bdun ma 'khyud rgya sngags dang bcas pa nas/ ko3haṃ gi bar/ oṃ sarba bid nas/ a warta ya ho bar/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lhag pa'i lha gyur pa/ /he ru ka dpal yab yum 'khor bcas bstod/ /bdag gi blo la snang ba'i phyi nang gi lha sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang / lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag go /rdzogs rim bzlas pa bsdu ba/ go cha gsum gyi bsrungs nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur/ zhes pa'i bar du sgrub thabs bzhin/ gtor ma 'bul na nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor dur khrod ces pa nas/ lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol gyi bar/ gdan sa 'di nyid du mdzad pa'i gtor bsngo chen mo bya ba'am/ yang na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho nas/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod kyi bar/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo dang / rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las sogs/ sh+lau ka gcig rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /chos kyi bar chad nyer zhi nas sogs la dril gsil bya/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rgyun bzhin la/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod kyi rjes su lha yi tshogs rnams nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar bde mchog sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bzhin/ rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rnams rgyun bzhin/ smon lam gyi tshig 'di la/ bla ma gong ma phal cher dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gang mdzad kyang /

smyo med kyai rdo rje ston/ /zhes gsungs pa de kha las tshig bsgyur mi mdzad/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen sogs kha cig smyo med 'khor lo bde mchog ston/ smyo med dus kyi 'khor lo ston sogs yi dam gang yin la tshig bsgyur mdzad pa'ang byung 'dug pas gang bde byas chog rjes yig brgya/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol rnams skabs su gang babs spyi 'gre/ cho ga gsum gyis bsrung ba dang / tsham rngam sngags bsrung dga' ba gsum dran pa/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis gang zhig sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshig ci rigs pa brjod do/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rnam pa lnga ni sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blangs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bde mchog nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs 'bring po nyams su len tshul 'di yang lha chen rab 'byams pa rgyal mtshan yar 'phel nas bde mchog gzhi bsnyen bgyis skabs 'di sogs gsal byed 'ga' re dgos zhes bskul ngor/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis dam pa gong ma'i gsung rab dang mthun par sbyar zhing / de dag dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs skabs rten gyi dkyil 'khor la zung 'brel med pa dang / dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtor ma 'bul ba gnyis bris kyang don gyi 'gal char 'gro min mkhas grub rnams kyis gzigs pas gsal zhing / de phyin bla ma gong ma'i gsung dang mthun pa kho na'o/ /yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pas so/ /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ nag po lugs kyi bde mchog sgrub thabs 'bring po nyams su len tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
